scope: Deterministic CPU analytic toy only; not traffic-policy recovery evidence
fixed_cohort: One active and started vehicle; no future departures
v_label: equal-probability expectation of the two exact Q labels
controls: Fresh bounded and unbounded models with identical named trainable parameter initialization, trained separately
optimizer: Adam, lr=0.003; full batch physical-return MSE; no normalization
failure_policy: Report failure at fixed budget; do not relax tolerances or optimize hyperparameters after results
limitations: Supervised analytic interpolation does not test SUMO, replay, learned latent sufficiency, TD stability or actor recovery; real policy gate not evaluated and this test never unfreezes actor
